summary: Available Summer 2024 · Large ground floor apartment · Modern Interior · Central Durham
description: My Property Box are delighted to welcome to the market this modern ground floor apartment at the popular Freemans Quay development, Durham. Available to students, the large two bedroom property includes; two large double bedrooms, one with en-suite. Family bathroom and generous open plan living room-kitchen with breakfast bar and balcony. Situated in the heart of Durham City, next to Freemans Quay Leisure Centre and Gala Square. Close to Durham University, local amenities and Durham train station. To arrange a viewing, contact MPB today and speak to the Lettings Team.
